scripts.text: - You hear a faint conversation going on inside. -
scripts.translation: - 你听见里面隐约传来谈话声。 -

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Once again, I have failed to
make the ^8B4513Jaty Crown^000000...
I was sure that I could do it this time.
Why won't it work?
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
又失败了，我还是没能打造出^8B4513贾提王冠^000000...
我明明觉得这次一定能成功。
到底哪里出了问题？

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
The ^006400Jaty Crown^000000 has been known to have miraculous power since the time of the ancients.
But it's been said only those who've earned a tribal honor
would be able to use it.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
^006400贾提王冠^000000自古以来就被认为拥有神奇的力量。
但据说，只有获得部落荣誉的人才有资格使用它。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
^0000FFKasyapa^000000!!
Are you saying that even though I am the leader of our tribe, I have not yet received that honor?
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
^0000FF迦叶^000000！！
你是说，我身为部落首领，却还没有获得那份荣誉吗？

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
Calm down ^0000FFChief Paiko^000000...
As the Great and Powerful Chief, you should be more than enough to qualify.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
请冷静，^0000FF派科首领^000000...
以您这位伟大而强大的首领的身份，当然完全够资格。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
In my younger years I could have easily solved the problem but this old man's mind cannot figure out what's missing.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
我年轻时本可以轻易解决这个问题，可如今老迈昏聩，实在想不出还缺了什么。

scripts.text: The conversation trails off and you don't hear any more.
scripts.translation: 谈话声渐渐消失，之后便再也听不到了。

scripts.text: Kasyapa and Chief Paiko begin talking as you are about to leave...
scripts.translation: 你正要离开时，迦叶和派科首领又交谈起来...

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
I am unsure of what is missing but that traveler could be big help in creating the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000.
Of this I am certain.
The reason is...
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
我不清楚还缺少什么，不过那位旅行者或许能帮我们打造^006400贾提王冠^000000。
这一点我很确定。
因为...

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
What is the reason?
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
为什么？

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
This ^8B4513Cendrawasih Feather^000000 was owned by our first tribe leader when the crown was originally created.
It was stored as a treasured heirloom of our tribe.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
这根^8B4513天堂鸟羽毛^000000曾属于我们部落的第一任首领。当年王冠就是由他打造的。
这根羽毛一直作为部落的珍贵传家宝保存至今。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
But when the traveler came near, this feather started to shine, and I kept thinking that this is not just a coincidence.
This person will be the key to assisting us to make the crown.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
可那位旅行者一靠近，羽毛就发出了光。我总觉得这绝非巧合。
那个人会是帮助我们打造王冠的关键。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Could it happen for sure?
If so, I will give everything
to support them...
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
真的有希望吗？
如果真是这样，我愿倾尽所有
支持他...

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
Ah, a stranger to our land.
Are you lost?
I hope you did not encounter much danger on your journey here.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
啊，是位远道而来的旅人。
你迷路了吗？
希望你一路上没遇到什么危险。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
Your earnest expression tells me
that you have something to say
you might as well tell me what it is.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
看你的神情，
似乎有话要说。
不妨直说吧。

scripts.text: I overheard talk about a crown?
scripts.translation: 我好像听到你们在谈论王冠？

scripts.text: Just looking for the gift shop.
scripts.translation: 我只是在找礼品店。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Really?
It looked as if your eyes
wanted to say something.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
真的？
可你的眼神
分明像是有话要说。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
Oh, you heard about the crown, eh?
Ah, this old man's got loose lips
we should have used a little more discretion...
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
哦，你听到王冠的事了？
唉，这老头子真是嘴上没把门，
我们本该谨慎些的...

scripts.text: Anything I can do to help?
scripts.translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
I can see in your eyes
that you are a trustworthy sort... but...
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
我看得出你值得信赖...不过...

scripts.text: There is a brief twinkling of light ^0000FFKasyapa^000000 all of sudden seems to be taken aback.
scripts.translation: 一道微光忽然闪过，^0000FF迦叶^000000顿时一惊。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
Ah, the feather......!
Instead of talking to me, why don't you talk to our tribe's leader, ^0000FFPaiko^000000.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
啊，是那根羽毛...！
别和我说了，去找我们部落的首领^0000FF派科^000000谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
Instead of talking to me, why don't you talk to our tribe's leader, ^0000FFChief Paiko^000000.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
别和我说了，去找我们部落的首领^0000FF派科^000000谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
If that's what Chief ^0000FFPaiko^000000 wants
I don't have any more to say.
Hmm....
but...... this....
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
既然这是^0000FF派科^000000首领的意思，
那我也没什么好说的。
嗯...
不过...这个...

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
Never mind, please have a good trip.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
算了，祝你一路顺风。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
I've been waiting for you traveler.
Our tribe's leader has a favor
to ask of you.
Please talk to Chief ^0000FFPaiko^000000.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
我一直在等你，旅行者。
我们部落的首领有事想拜托你。
请去找^0000FF派科^000000首领。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
I heard you could help making a crown
for our tribe leader.
You will certainly be
a big help to us...
I trust my own eyes!
And also the sparkling light...
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
我听说你愿意帮部落首领打造王冠。
你一定能帮上大忙...
我相信自己的眼睛！
还有那闪耀的光芒...

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
The symbol of Dayak Tribe
and a famous mystical creature.
Find 15 of ^006400Cendrawasih Feather^000000
and bring them to Chief ^0000FFPaiko^000000.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
天堂鸟是达雅克部落的象征，
也是闻名遐迩的神秘生物。
请收集 15 根^006400天堂鸟羽毛^000000，
交给^0000FF派科^000000首领。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
With the feathers that you have brought creating a ^006400Jaty Crown^000000 is going much more smoothly.
Go see Chief ^0000FFPaiko^000000.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
有了你带来的羽毛，打造^006400贾提王冠^000000就顺利多了。
去找^0000FF派科^000000首领吧。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
There is something
I wish to give to you
as a reward for your help.
Please, it would honor us if you would take it.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
为了答谢你的帮助，
我想送你一件礼物。
请务必收下，这是我们的荣幸。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
You are carrying too much weight over the limit.
I cannot get you your reward unless you reduce the amount of weighty items you are carrying.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
你的负重已超出上限。
请先减轻负重，否则我无法把奖励交给你。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
You are carrying too much in your inventory.
I will give you the reward once you unburden yourself and return.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
你的背包快装满了。
先清出些空间再回来，我会把奖励给你。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
The reason I asked you to embark on this important mission is because of this feather.
Handed down from generation to generation the legendary origin of the crown is this feather...
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
我之所以请你执行这项重要任务，就是因为这根羽毛。
它代代相传，也是王冠传奇起源的见证...

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
I saw this feather begin to shine when you came here.
I knew you were a person who
would endeavour to help us.
On behalf of my people
I give my thanks.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
你刚来时，我看见这根羽毛发出了光。
我知道你一定愿意帮助我们。
我谨代表族人，
向你致谢。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
Also, the feather you received isn't just valuable on its own, it also is an acknowledgment from our tribe.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
还有，你得到的这根羽毛不仅十分珍贵，也代表我们部落对你的认可。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
Like ^8B4513Krakatau^000000 Volcano, when you venture into dangerous areas like that, if you display this feather, you can get help from the tribe.
Anyway, I really thank you.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
今后若要前往^8B4513喀拉喀托火山^000000一类的危险地区，展示这根羽毛，部落的人就会出手相助。
无论如何，真的非常感谢你。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
Also, the feather you received isn't just valuable on its own, it also is an acknowledgment from our tribe.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
还有，你得到的这根羽毛不仅十分珍贵，也代表我们部落对你的认可。

scripts.text:
[Sage Kasyapa]
Like ^8B4513Krakatau^000000 Volcano, when you venture into dangerous areas like that, if you display this feather, you can get help from the tribe.
Anyway, I really thank you.
scripts.translation:
[贤者 迦叶]
今后若要前往^8B4513喀拉喀托火山^000000一类的危险地区，展示这根羽毛，部落的人就会出手相助。
无论如何，真的非常感谢你。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
I am the leader of this tribe
^0000FFPaiko^000000
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
我就是这个部落的首领，
^0000FF派科^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
I can see you are a traveler,
from another land.
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
看得出来，你是来自异乡的旅人。
你来这里做什么？

scripts.text: I overheard the story by accident
scripts.translation: 我无意中听到了那个故事。

scripts.text: I have nothing to say.
scripts.translation: 我没什么想说的。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
You are wasting your time here.
There are many other attractions around our village.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
你在这里也是白费工夫。
村子周围还有不少别的景点。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
What do you mean?
You heard the story about a crown?
You must have heard incorrectly.
I have nothing to say to you
regarding such things.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
你什么意思？
你听到了王冠的事？
你一定是听错了。
我没什么可跟你说的。

scripts.text: Kasyapa was talking about a crown...
scripts.translation: 迦叶刚才在说王冠...

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
It seems that ^0000FFKasyapa^000000 has told you a tall tale and I appreciate your concern about our affairs.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
看来^0000FF迦叶^000000跟你说了不少离奇故事。感谢你关心我们部落的事。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
It's not something that a stranger like you could understand so make like a tree, and get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
这不是你这种外人能明白的。识相点，赶紧离开这里。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
There are many other attractions around our village.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
村子周围还有不少别的景点。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
If it's about the crown I want you to stop asking about it.
Please leave.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
如果你是来问王冠的，就别再打听了。
请离开吧。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
I've been waiting for you, traveler
according to sage ^0000FFKasyapa^000000
You are willing to help us make a crown for our tribe.
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
The Tribe leader has the duty of making and protecting the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000 to uphold the tribe's pride and honor.
scripts.translation:
[部落酋长派科]
旅行者，我一直在等你。
正如贤者^0000FF迦叶^000000所说，
你愿意帮我们部落制作王冠。
[部落酋长派科]
部落首领有责任制作并守护^006400贾蒂王冠^000000，以维护部落的荣耀与尊严。

scripts.text: Crown-a-whatsis?
scripts.translation: 王冠？什么玩意儿？

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
But, ever since I became the tribe leader there have been difficulties making it.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
可自从我当上首领，打造王冠就一直不顺利。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
According to Sage ^0000FFKasyapa^000000, you can help us create a ^006400Jaty Crown^000000.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
贤者^0000FF迦叶^000000说，你能帮我们打造^006400贾提王冠^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Do you think you can help?
Your efforts will not go unrewarded.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
你愿意帮忙吗？
我们不会让你的努力白费。

scripts.text: Ok, I will help
scripts.translation: 好，我来帮忙。

scripts.text: I am sorry, I cannot help now.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我现在帮不了你。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
That's really sad.
If you ever change
your mind, please
come again.
I will be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
真遗憾。
如果你改变主意了，
请再来找我。
我会等着你。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Many thanks to you, stranger
If Kasyapa trusts you then I know that you can help us make a
^006400Jaty Crown^000000
What you can do to
help us is very simple.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
陌生人，非常感谢你。
既然迦叶信任你，我相信你能帮我们打造^006400贾提王冠^000000。
你要做的事很简单。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
The symbol of the Jaty Tribe is also a famous mystical creature.
Find 15 ^006400Cendrawasih Feather^000000s and bring them to me.
Our faith is in you, stranger.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
天堂鸟是贾提部落的象征，也是一种闻名遐迩的神秘生物。
请收集 15 根^006400天堂鸟羽毛^000000带给我。
陌生人，我们相信你。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
It seems that you have yet to find the materials to make the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
看来你还没找到打造^006400贾提王冠^000000所需的材料。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
The symbol of the Dayak Tribe is also a famous mystical creature.
Find 15 ^006400Cendrawasih Feather^000000s and bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
天堂鸟是达雅克部落的象征，也是一种闻名遐迩的神秘生物。
请收集 15 根^006400天堂鸟羽毛^000000带给我。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Oh! You've found all of them. Look! The feathers you have found are sparkling. Aren't they?
Alright, let me begin crafting the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000 I feel that I am ready.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
哦！你全都找齐了。快看，这些羽毛在发光呢！
好，我这就开始打造^006400贾提王冠^000000。感觉时机已经成熟了。

scripts.text: Suddenly, a large noise begins to boom as you and ^0000FFPaiko^000000 are surrounded by warm and bright sparkling energy like a thousand tinkling fireflies.
scripts.translation: 忽然一声巨响，你和^0000FF派科^000000被温暖明亮的闪耀能量包围，四周仿佛有上千只萤火虫在闪烁。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
With your help the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000 is coming along nicely.
It will take some time until the task is finished so please wait a little.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
多亏了你，^006400贾提王冠^000000的打造进展顺利。
完工还需要一些时间，请稍等。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
After the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000 is complete, there is a gift that I want to give to you.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
^006400贾提王冠^000000完工后，我有份礼物要送给你。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Ah, also you should go see Sage ^0000FFKasyapa^000000 who really wants to reward you with something.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
啊，对了，贤者^0000FF迦叶^000000也很想送你一份谢礼，你去见见他吧。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Ah, you should talk to Sage ^0000FFKasyapa^000000 who really wants to reward you with something.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
啊，你去和贤者^0000FF迦叶^000000谈谈吧。他很想送你一份谢礼。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
With your support I am not worrying about creating the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000.
I really appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
有你的支持，我就不用担心^006400贾提王冠^000000的事了。
真的很感谢你。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
A delightful day like today should be celebrated. Don't you think?
So I prepared to sample the special food of our tribe, called ^006400Satay^000000
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
今天这么值得庆祝，你说是不是？
我准备了我们部落的特色美食^006400沙嗲^000000，想让大家尝尝。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
But, this ^006400Satay^000000 is too tasty for just the two of us to share so we would like to share it with people out in the village.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
这份^006400沙嗲^000000美味极了，光我们两个人吃太可惜。我想分给村里的人尝尝。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
What do you think?
In order to share news that
the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000 is being successfully crafted and to share the delicious ^006400Satay^000000 with our friends, I need your help.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
你觉得如何？
我想告诉大家^006400贾提王冠^000000打造顺利的好消息，也想和朋友们分享美味的^006400沙嗲^000000。你能帮我吗？

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Are you up for a short delivery job?
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
愿意帮忙跑一趟送东西吗？

scripts.text: Of course, I can help
scripts.translation: 当然，我来帮忙。

scripts.text: Sorry, I am too busy to help.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我现在太忙了，帮不了你。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
I believed you would definitely help me...
It's a little disappointing.
If you ever change your mind
come speak with me again.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
我还以为你一定会帮我呢...
真有点失望。
如果你改变主意了，
再来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Oh!, I knew you'd help.
Our tribe's warriors come to my mind before we share with anyone else.
Please share Satay with the warriors in the village.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
哦！我就知道你会答应。
我想先把沙嗲送给部落的战士们。
请把沙嗲分给村里的战士吧。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
For the moment I will give you 2 ^006400Satay^000000.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
先给你 2 份^006400沙嗲^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
You may be tempted by the aroma of our ^006400Satay^000000 and you may eat one but, if you eat more than that you won't be able to share the ^006400Satay^000000
with our village friends.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
你可能会被^006400沙嗲^000000的香味勾得想尝一份，不过最多只能吃一份。吃多了，就没法把剩下的^006400沙嗲^000000分给村里的朋友了。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
It seems that you have yet to deliver the ^006400Satay^000000.
Did you run into any problems?
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
看来你还没把^006400沙嗲^000000送到。
路上出什么问题了吗？

scripts.text: I ate them all.
scripts.translation: 我全吃光了。

scripts.text: Deliver to whom.
scripts.translation: 要送给谁？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Huh... so you couldn't resist yourself, eh?
Don't blame yourself too much. It is difficult to resist the ^006400Satay^000000's addicting aroma.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
啊...看来你还是没抵挡住诱惑？
别太自责，^006400沙嗲^000000的香味确实让人难以抗拒。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Our tribe is short on food supplies so we can't give out more of our ^006400Satay^000000, but there's a rumor that the restaurant owner in Dewata Island is making and selling their own ^006400Satay^000000.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
我们部落的粮食不够，没法再给你^006400沙嗲^000000了。不过听说德瓦他岛上的餐厅老板也在自制^006400沙嗲^000000出售。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Alright! Deliver it right now!
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
好！现在就去送吧！

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
It is not as tasty as our tribe's recipe, but this is an urgent task so just find it and deliver it.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
味道虽然比不上我们部落的秘方，但眼下这事很急，你只管买来送过去。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Our tribe warriors come to my mind to deliver the food to share Satay with warriors in the village.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
先把食物送给部落的战士们，和他们分享沙嗲吧。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Ah, the next person whom I want the ^006400Satay^000000 delivered to is someone who stays across from the river, the ^0000FFTribe Manager^000000.
scripts.translation:

啊，下一个要送^006400沙嗲^000000的人，是住在河对岸的^0000FF部落管理员^000000。

scripts.text:

To this end, I will give you 2 more servings of ^006400Satay^000000.

这趟再给你 2 份^006400沙嗲^000000。

scripts.text:

I'll give you 2 more servings of ^006400Satay^000000 for this delivery.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

^8B4513德瓦他岛^000000。
趁沙嗲还热着，赶紧送过去吧。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Oh, you have delivered it.
You've done good work.
It has been a good time for all of us to share and enjoy this happy occasion together. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
哦，已经送到了。
你做得很好。
大家能一起分享美食、共度这个喜庆时刻，真是太好了。谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
While you were on the way back from delivering the ^006400Satay^000000,
the Jaty Crown has been made. Its ambience and radiance make it a truly flawless crown.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
你送完^006400沙嗲^000000回来时，贾提王冠已经打造完成。它光彩夺目、气度非凡，堪称完美。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Also, you brought more than enough materials so after making the ^006400Jaty Crown^000000, we were able to craft a similar one for you to keep.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
而且你带来的材料绰绰有余。打造完^006400贾提王冠^000000后，我们还仿制了一顶送给你留念。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
It's not the same as the original, but it has its own specialty. It is my reward to thank you for what you have done.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
这顶王冠虽不及原版，却也别有特色。就把它作为谢礼，感谢你为我们所做的一切。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
You are carrying too much weight to receive your reward.
Please reduce your carried weight and come back again.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
你的负重太高，无法领取奖励。
请减轻负重后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
Made with our tribe's secret marinade try the ^006400Satay^000000.
It was made with all our heart, especially for you, but don't forget to share it with friends.
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
尝尝这份用部落秘制腌料做的^006400沙嗲^000000吧。
这是我们特地为你精心准备的，可别忘了分给朋友尝尝。

scripts.text:
[Tribal Chief Paiko]
You've done good work.
Whatever you do in the future, I wish for you to have a life which is full of fortune and joy.
As Chief of the ^8B4513Jaty Tribe^000000, I wish you the best of luck!!
scripts.translation:
[部落首领 派科]
你做得很好。
无论将来做什么，我都祝你一生幸福、好运常伴。
我以^8B4513贾提部落^000000首领之名，祝你一切顺利！！

scripts.text:
[Jaty Tribe Warrior]
We revere strength and bravery.
We are ^FF0000Jaty^000000 Tribe.
scripts.translation:
[贾提部落战士]
我们崇尚力量与勇气。
我们是^FF0000贾提^000000部落。

scripts.text:
[Jaty Tribe Warrior]
My trained eyes see that
you seem about to say something.
Speak, and state your business.
scripts.translation:
[贾提部落战士]
我这双练过的眼睛看得出来，
你似乎有话要说。
说吧，来此有何贵干？

scripts.text: ^0000FFTribal Chief Paiko^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF部落首领 派科^000000

scripts.text:
[Jaty Tribe Warrior]
I've heard about your
helpful deeds...
As a representative of my tribe
I express my thanks to you.
scripts.translation:
[贾提部落战士]
我听说了你为我们所做的事...
我谨代表部落，向你致谢。

scripts.text:
[Jaty Tribe Warrior]
Also, thank you for the ^006400Satay^000000
My mouth is already watering thank you.
There is something I would like to share with you regarding our tribe.
scripts.translation:
[贾提部落战士]
还有，谢谢你送来的^006400沙嗲^000000。
光是闻着香味我就要流口水了。
我想和你说说我们部落的事。

scripts.text:
[Jaty Tribe Warrior]
Unlike the ancient times when our tribe's warriors fought and shed their blood the world has become more peaceful nowadays but our tribe's territory has shrunk drastically.
scripts.translation:
[贾提部落战士]
古时候，部落战士们征战四方、浴血奋战；如今世道和平了许多，我们部落的领地却大幅缩小。

scripts.text:
[Jaty Tribe Warrior]
Nevertheless we will continue keeping the warrior tradition of our tribe alive and we will preserve the pride we have earned through the sacrifice of those past warriors.
scripts.translation:
[贾提部落战士]
即便如此，我们仍会延续部落的战士传统，守护先辈战士用牺牲换来的荣耀。

scripts.text:
[Jaty Tribe Warrior]
I hope that your perseverance and pride remain with you in your travels.
scripts.translation:
[贾提部落战士]
愿你在旅途中也能坚守信念、珍视自己的荣誉。

scripts.text:
[Tribe Manager]
Keeping our culture and tradition is very important.
scripts.translation:
[部落管理员]
守护我们的文化与传统非常重要。

scripts.text:
[Tribe Manager]
Keeping our culture and tradition is very important.
Although it is a little boring...
scripts.translation:
[部落管理员]
守护我们的文化与传统非常重要。
虽然有时确实有点无聊...

scripts.text:
[Tribe Manager]
It seems to me that you have something
to say, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[部落管理员]
看起来你有话要对我说？

scripts.text: ^0000FFTribal Chief Paiko^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF部落首领 派科^000000

scripts.text:
[Tribe Manager]
I didn't know that there was
such an effort being put forth
and that you took a key role in the effort...
You are the hero of the^8B4513Jaty Tribe^000000.
scripts.translation:
[部落管理员]
我没想到你竟为此付出了这么多，还发挥了关键作用...
你是^8B4513贾提部落^000000的英雄。

scripts.text:
[Tribe Manager]
Wow~ the savory scent of
delicious homemade ^006400Satay^000000!!
Thank you for the meal.
Please give my regards
to our Tribe Leader.
scripts.translation:
[部落管理员]
哇~ 自制^006400沙嗲^000000真香啊！
谢谢款待。
请代我向部落首领问好。

scripts.text:
[Tribe Manager]
There are few contacts between
^8B4513Dewata Island^000000 and ^8B4513Jaty tribe^000000.
We used to have a stronger bond
in older times.
scripts.translation:
[部落管理员]
^8B4513德瓦他岛^000000和^8B4513贾提部落^000000往来不多。
过去，我们的关系曾经亲密得多。

scripts.text:
[Tribe Manager]
But with new culture and foreigners flowing in
^8B4513Dewata Island^000000 has became a tourist attraction and we have lost touch with them.
scripts.translation:
[部落管理员]
随着新文化兴起、外来者不断涌入，^8B4513德瓦他岛^000000成了观光胜地，我们也渐渐和他们疏远了。

scripts.text:
[Tribe Manager]
The tourist attraction has expanded continuously but the reason it hasn't influenced us here is due to this small temple which I am managing.
scripts.translation:
[部落管理员]
观光区不断扩大，却没有影响到我们这里，这都要归功于我管理的这座小神庙。

scripts.text:
[Tribe Manager]
I couldn't let our tradition fade away like that easily.
I hope keeping our tradition and culture alive lets people know how important these things are to us.
scripts.translation:
[部落管理员]
我不能眼看着传统就这样消失。
希望我们延续传统、守护文化的努力，能让人们明白这些对我们有多重要。

scripts.text:
[Tribe Manager]
From now on, I hope people from ^8B4513Dewata Island^000000 and ^8B4513Jaty Tribe^000000 can get along and interact more often.
scripts.translation:
[部落管理员]
今后，我希望^8B4513德瓦他岛^000000和^8B4513贾提部落^000000的人们能和睦相处、多多往来。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
^8B4513Krakatau Volcano^000000 is
a very dangerous area
I cannot allow anyone to go in there.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守门人]
^8B4513喀拉喀托火山^000000非常危险，
我不能放任何人进去。

scripts.text: Allow me through
scripts.translation: 让我进去。

scripts.text: I don't want to go in{0}
scripts.translation: 我不想进去{0}

scripts.translation: 我不想进去

scripts.text: ^0000FFTribal Chief Paiko^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF部落酋长派科^000000

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
^8B4513Krakatau Volcano^000000 is
a very dangerous area
so I can't allow you in
unless you qualify for entry.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守门人]
^8B4513喀拉喀托火山^000000非常危险。
除非你符合入内资格，否则我不能放你进去。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
You are the traveler who was acknowledged by tribe leader as a friend of the tribe and received a ^006400Shining Cendrawasih Feather^000000.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守门人]
你就是那位得到部落首领认可、成为部落朋友，并获赠^006400闪耀的天堂鸟羽毛^000000的旅行者吧。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
Well, I will let you pass but ^8B4513Krakatau Volcano^000000 is dangerous so please take care.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守门人]
好吧，我放你过去。不过^8B4513喀拉喀托火山^000000很危险，务必小心。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
You have chosen wisely.
^8B4513Krakatau Volcano^000000 is
an extremely dangerous area.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守门人]
你选得明智。
^8B4513喀拉喀托火山^000000是个极其危险的地方。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
Oh! I didn't know about that!
This is some of the best news
I have heard recently.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守门人]
哦！我还不知道这件事！
这是我最近听到的最好的消息。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
Um, what is this wonderful smell?
Of course, it's our ^006400Satay^000000!
I was slightly hungry
so this should fill me up.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守门人]
嗯，这是什么香味？
当然是我们的^006400沙嗲^000000！
我正好有点饿，
这下可以饱餐一顿了。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
Since you came all the way here
I will share you an interesting story.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守门人]
你大老远来到这里，
我就给你讲个有趣的故事吧。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
It has become a lost tradition in recent years but until 10 or more years ago in order to become a ^8B4513Jaty Tribe^000000 warrior you had to climb Krakatau Volcano to prove your endurance.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守门人]
这项传统近些年已经失传了。十多年前，想成为^8B4513贾提部落^000000的战士，就必须攀登喀拉喀托火山，以证明自己的耐力。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
The eyes of those warriors were anxious yet determined before going up ^8B4513Krakatau Volcano^000000.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守门人]
那些战士登上^8B4513喀拉喀托火山^000000前，眼中既有不安，也有坚定。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
I still cannot forget that look in their eyes I feel a little bit the same emotion from you Adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守门人]
我至今忘不了他们当时的眼神。冒险者，我觉得你身上也有几分相同的情绪。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
I want you to live long and prosper.
Be healthy and safe, traveler so you can live to tell the tale of your adventures.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守门人]
愿你长寿安康，万事顺遂。旅行者，保重身体、一路平安，日后才能平安讲述自己的冒险经历。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
Want to go back
to Dewata?
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守门人]
要回德瓦他吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 要。

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不要。

scripts.text:
[Gatekeeper of Krakatau Volcano]
^8B4513Krakatau Volcano^000000 is
a dangerous place.
You should go back now.
scripts.translation:
[喀拉喀托火山守门人]
^8B4513喀拉喀托火山^000000很危险。
你现在该回去了。

scripts.text:
[Borobudur Temple Manager]
The weather today is so beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[婆罗浮屠神庙管理员]
今天天气真好。

scripts.text:
[Borobudur Temple Manager]
By the way, do you have
something to tell me...?
scripts.translation:
[婆罗浮屠神庙管理员]
对了，你有事要告诉我吗...？

scripts.text: ^0000FFTribal Chief Paiko^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000FF部落首领 派科^000000

scripts.text:
[Borobudur Temple Manager]
I never knew such a thing had happened.
If you had told me in advance, I could have helped at least a little bit.
Still things have gone well with your help.
scripts.translation:
[婆罗浮屠神庙管理员]
我真不知道竟然发生了这种事。
你要是早点告诉我，我至少还能帮上一点忙。
不过有你出手，事情总算顺利解决了。

scripts.text:
[Borobudur Temple Manager]
Ah, it is the ^006400Satay^00000 that I sampled when the tribe invited me some time ago.
scripts.translation:
[婆罗浮屠神庙管理员]
啊，这是之前部落邀请我品尝过的^006400沙嗲^00000。

scripts.text:
[Borobudur Temple Manager]
Good~~ This is the same taste I remember.
To give my thanks I will pass along a story that may interest you
scripts.translation:
[婆罗浮屠神庙管理员]
好吃~~ 就是这个熟悉的味道。
为了答谢你，我告诉你一个有趣的故事吧。

scripts.text:
[Borobudur Temple Manager]
Legend tells of a strange bird called ^FF0000Garuda^000000.
It has the torso, arms and legs of a human but has the head and beak of an eagle.
scripts.translation:
[婆罗浮屠神庙管理员]
传说中有一种奇异的鸟，名叫^FF0000迦楼罗^000000。
它有人的躯干、手臂和双腿，却长着鹰的头和喙。

scripts.text:
[Borobudur Temple Manager]
The Story of this bird describes it helping the gods exterminate wicked demons and snakes.
scripts.translation:
[婆罗浮屠神庙管理员]
传说它曾帮助众神消灭邪恶的恶魔与蛇。

scripts.text:
[Borobudur Temple Manager]
The tale has been passed down from generation to generation.
Quite interesting, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[婆罗浮屠神庙管理员]
这个故事代代相传。
很有意思吧？

scripts.text:
[Borobudur Temple Manager]
I am sure in the village of the ^8B4513Jaty Tribe^000000 there are many legendary stories.
When I get to meet the Chief, I will hear many such stories for sure.
scripts.translation:
[婆罗浮屠神庙管理员]
我相信^8B4513贾提部落^000000的村子里也有许多传奇故事。
等我见到首领，一定要听他讲讲。

scripts.text:
[Borobudur Temple Manager]
I am not certain of when we will cross paths again but I hope we will meet again someday.
I wish you a pleasant journey, young traveler.
scripts.translation:
[婆罗浮屠神庙管理员]
不知我们何时才能再见，但希望总有一天还能重逢。
祝你旅途愉快，年轻的旅行者。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Why are you carrying so much? Doesn't that hurt your back?
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
你怎么带了这么多东西？背着不累吗？

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Is it a trend for youngsters to carry heavy things?
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
现在的年轻人都流行背这么重的东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Will you help me again tomorrow?
Poby still has a back pain.
Backaches don't just go away after one day.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
明天还能再来帮我吗？
波比的背还疼着呢。
背痛可不是一天就能好的。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Dewata is always crowded but today is quiet.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
德瓦他平时总是很热闹，今天却格外安静。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Oh god! We don't have a message from the Jaty tribe yet.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
哎呀！我们还没收到贾提部落的消息呢。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
They have never broken a promise for 10 years, I do not know the reason. What's happening?
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
他们十年来从未失约过，我实在想不出原因。到底发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Memo]
I might spoil all the liquid if it is going on like this.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
再这样下去，这些酒恐怕都要坏掉了。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
What should I do? I still don't have any news from the Jaty tribe.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
怎么办？我还是没收到贾提部落的消息。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Oh no~ All the liquid is going to spoil...
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
糟了~ 这些酒都要坏掉了...

scripts.text: What happened?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Memo]
You are an adventurer, right?
As you can see from the jars around me, I am making ^0000FFtraditional wine^000000 for a living.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
你是冒险者吧？
就像你看到的这些酒坛一样，我靠酿造^0000FF传统酒^000000为生。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Everyone knows about this, so ^0000FFDewata island^000000 attracts many tourists.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
这里的酒远近闻名，所以^0000FF德瓦他岛^000000吸引了许多游客。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Especially this traditional wine, which has been made for four generations! But ^FF0000Ark^000000 is short of supply.
Ark needs ^0000FFPalm Oils^000000, made from Oil Palm Fruit.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
尤其是这款已经传了四代的传统酒！不过，^FF0000阿拉克酒^000000快要断货了。
阿拉克酒需要用油棕果榨出的^0000FF棕榈油^000000来酿。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Unfortunately, we haven't been getting ^0000FFPalm Oil^000000 from the Jaty tribe village lately.
The ingredients might be useless if it is delivered too late.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
最近贾提部落村子那边一直没送来^0000FF棕榈油^000000。
要是送得太晚，原料就派不上用场了。

scripts.text: Sounds like a big problem.
scripts.translation: 听起来事情挺严重的。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
It is more of a problem than you think. Sales are credit, but if we do not make due today, we'll lose the credit, the ingredients, and the tourists who do not get the Ark. So it's quite damaging.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
比你想的还严重。我们是赊账销售，今天要是没能按时交货，不仅会失去信誉、浪费原料，还会让买不到阿拉克酒的游客失望，损失可不小。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Ah, right! Are you busy now?
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
啊，对了！你现在有空吗？

scripts.text: Sorry, I am busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我现在没空。

scripts.text: No, I am not busy.
scripts.translation: 我有空。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Hmm, I have no choice.
You don't care that others are in trouble. What has this world come to?
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
唉，那我也没办法。
别人有难，你却一点也不在乎。
这世道到底怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Memo]
That's good to hear.
So since you are wandering here...
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
那就好。
既然你正好在附近...

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Do you mind if I ask you a favor~? Actually I have to visit the Jaty Tribe, but this unmatured ^FF0000Ark^000000 won't let me leave.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
能不能请你帮我个忙~？我本来得去一趟贾提部落，可这批阿拉克酒^FF0000还没酿好^000000，实在走不开。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Will you go to Jaty village and ask ^0000FFLero^000000 what happened?
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
你能去贾提村问问^0000FF莱罗^000000出了什么事吗？

scripts.text:
[Memo]
This guy has never broken a promise for 10 years, so he must have a really good reason not to come.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
那家伙十年来从没失约过，这次没来一定有他的理由。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Find the best oil master.
His name again is ^0000FFLero^000000.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
去找最厉害的榨油师傅。
名字是^0000FF莱罗^000000。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
So, what did Lero say?
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
那么，莱罗怎么说？

scripts.text:
[Memo]
You didn't find out what happened?
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
你没打听到发生什么事吗？

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Find the best oil master. His name is ^0000FFLero^000000.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
去找最厉害的榨油师傅，他叫^0000FF莱罗^000000。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
So, what did Lero say?
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
那么，莱罗怎么说？

scripts.text: Palm tree... became.
scripts.translation: 棕榈树...变成了。

scripts.text: - You explain the situation to Mr. Memo -
scripts.translation: - 你把事情经过告诉了梅莫。 -

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Lero said sorry?
Hmm, it's okay.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
莱罗说抱歉？
嗯，没关系。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
That must be ^0000FFPoby^000000. If he has been hurt, that's why there wasn't any message. Lero actually cares about him a lot...
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
那一定是^0000FF波比^000000。要是他受伤了，莱罗就没法送消息过来。莱罗其实很关心他...

scripts.text:
[Memo]
He might be troublesome, but please visit the Jaty village. Lero must complete the oil.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
虽然这事有点棘手，还是请你去一趟贾提村吧。莱罗得把棕榈油榨好。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
If it is not, wait there and bring ^FF000030 bottles of oil^000000 to me.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
要是还没准备好，就在那里等一等，再带^FF000030瓶棕榈油^000000回来。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
He might be troublesome, but please visit the Jaty village. Lero must complete the oil.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
虽然这事有点棘手，还是请你去一趟贾提村吧。莱罗得把棕榈油榨好。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
If it is not, wait there and bring ^FF000030 bottles of oil^000000 to me.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
要是还没准备好，就在那里等一等，再带^FF000030瓶棕榈油^000000回来。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Oh, didn't I tell you to bring 30 bottles of oil? Did you forget?
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
咦，我不是让你带 30 瓶油回来吗？你忘了？

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Go back to Lero and get more, he will give you more if it was your mistake.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
回去找莱罗再拿一些吧。要是你的疏忽，他会再给你油的。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
You brought the oil. Good job, and thank you.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
你把油带回来了。做得好，谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Excuse me, but I have an urgent matter to attend to. Can you wait for a while and talk to me when I'm done?
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
抱歉，我有急事要处理。能请你稍等一会儿，等我忙完再来找我吗？

scripts.text: - Memo is making an ark. -
scripts.translation: - 梅莫正在酿造阿拉克酒。 -

scripts.text: - There is error in the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 任务发生错误。 -

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Did I make you wait too long?
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
让你久等了。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
My family has been making Arks for four generations.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
我们家酿造阿拉克酒已经四代了。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Grandfather had a hard living since he didn't get many good sales.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
祖父那时生意不好，日子过得很艰难。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Dewata island people do not drink much in the hot weather.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
天气炎热时，德瓦他岛上的人不怎么喝酒。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
When I was young, Dewata developed as a tourist attraction and that's when the ^FF00FFtour package^000000 Ark started selling well.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
我小时候，德瓦他发展成了观光胜地，那时^FF00FF阿拉克酒旅游套装^000000开始畅销。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Good liquid needs fresh oil. I was able to make liquid for ten years and deliver it all on time.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
酿好酒离不开新鲜棕榈油。我酿酒已经十年了，每次都能按时交货。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Because today's oil has not arrived on time, I think I might have a hard time.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
今天的棕榈油没能按时送到，接下来恐怕要麻烦了。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
You helped me to make the liquid correctly.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
多亏你帮忙，我总算顺利把酒酿好了。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
This proverb ^0000FF'Mengatakan mudah, mengerjakan susah.'^000000 means it is easy to say something but hard to do anything.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
这句谚语^0000FF“Mengatakan mudah, mengerjakan susah.”^000000的意思是：说来容易，做起来难。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
In other words, it's easy to say that we'll help others but it's hard to actually do the action.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
换句话说，嘴上说要帮人很容易，真正行动起来却不简单。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
You really did a great job. I like you because you are different from today's youngins.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
你真是帮了大忙。我喜欢你这样的人，和现在那些年轻人不一样。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Will you help me with my work from time to time?
I will pay you for what you do for me.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
以后有空能常来帮我干活吗？
我会付你报酬。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
{0}, to what do I owe the pleasure?
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
{0}，今天怎么有空过来？

scripts.text: Just came by to say hello.
scripts.translation: 我只是来打个招呼。

scripts.text: I will help you.
scripts.translation: 我来帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
I guess you are busy.
If possible, will you get the oil from Lero? I will appreciate it...
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
看来你挺忙的。
要是方便的话，能帮我去莱罗那里取些棕榈油吗？那就太感谢了...

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Thank you. I know that you're busy and helping me can be a chore.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
谢谢你。我知道你很忙，帮我的忙也挺费事的。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Can you help Lero and bring back palm tree oil...?
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
能帮莱罗一把，把棕榈油带回来吗...？

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Can you help Lero and bring back palm tree oil...?
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
能帮莱罗一把，把棕榈油带回来吗...？

scripts.text:
[Memo]
You haven't brought enough oil.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
你带回来的油还不够。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Poby owes me a few things, he'll give you some.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
波比还欠我几样东西，他会给你一些。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Oh you brought the oil, good job.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
哦，你把油带回来了，做得不错。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
You must've had a hard time bringing the oil so here take this drink.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
你辛苦把油送来，喝点这个吧。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Ark is famous for tourists, a guy bought many bottles by himself.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
阿拉克酒很受游客欢迎，曾有个人一次就买了好几瓶。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Worrying that he'll drink alone? Too much drink always becomes poisonous.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
你担心他一个人喝吗？酒喝多了总会伤身的。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
The sun always rises in the East. The well known laziness wakes up early in the morning.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
太阳总会从东方升起。那个出了名的懒汉，今天倒是起得挺早。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Does he come to reality? He is good but lazy.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
他总算清醒过来了？人倒不坏，就是懒。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
The first blow is half the battle.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
好的开始，等于成功了一半。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
I think that you're destined to do great things.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
我觉得你注定会成就一番大事。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
There's a man saying blow hot and cold, it seems that a word is easy but it is not.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
有人总是反复无常...看来说起来容易，做起来难啊。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
I believe that you will hold true to your promise.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
我相信你会信守诺言。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
I want you to help me this time.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
这次我想请你帮个忙。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Poby still has back pains and it will take some days for him to recover.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
波比的背还疼着，恐怕还得过几天才能恢复。

scripts.text:
[Memo]
Dewata island is always crowded but today is quiet.
scripts.translation:
[梅莫]
德瓦他岛平时总是人来人往，今天却格外安静。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
You're carrying too many things...
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
你带的东西太多了...

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Oh no! I have so many orders and I'm running out of ingredients.
Not yet? What's going on, Poby? Where did he go?
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
糟了！订单堆成山，原料却快用完了。
还没回来吗？波比到底怎么回事？他去哪儿了？

scripts.text: Excuse me, but are you Lero?
scripts.translation: 不好意思，请问你是莱罗吗？

scripts.text:
[Lero]
When Poby gets back here, I'm gonna give him a beating he'll never forget!
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
等波比回来，我非好好教训他一顿不可！

scripts.text: - Lero seems pretty mad at someone and ignores you -
scripts.translation: - 莱罗似乎正在生某人的气，根本没注意到你。 -

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Oops. Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
哎呀，你是谁？

scripts.text: Memo sent me here.
scripts.translation: 梅莫让我来的。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Ah, right! I forgot about Memo because the workers who gather nuts have not come yet. Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
啊，对了！采坚果的工人还没回来，我把梅莫的事给忘了。抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
To make fresh palm oils, I need fresh Palm Oil Fruit. Then I'll be able to get more fresh oil from its fresh fruit.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
要榨出新鲜棕榈油，就得用新鲜的油棕果。只有果子新鲜，榨出的油才够好。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Between you and me, Mr. Memo is so fussy that he will not use any unfresh oil.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
悄悄告诉你，梅莫先生很挑剔，一点也不肯用不新鲜的油。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
To make fresh oil, he always sends the workers to palm tree forest, but... the guys sent at dawn have not come back yet.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
为了榨出新鲜的油，他总是派工人去棕榈树林采果子。可是...一大早派去的人到现在还没回来。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
First, I thought that he was lazy and it made me very uneasy.
Can you find the workers in the palm forest?
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
一开始我还以为他偷懒，心里一直放心不下。
你能去棕榈树林找找那些工人吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I will find them.
scripts.translation: 好，我去找他们。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Thank you so much.
Find Poby.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
太感谢你了。
去找波比吧。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Poby might in ^0000FFPalm Forest^000000. The crop is best at the southern part of the forest.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
波比可能在^0000FF棕榈森林^000000。森林南边的果子长得最好。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Did you find Poby?
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
找到波比了吗？

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Oh, you haven't visited the east of ^0000FFPalm Forest^000000 yet. I'm pretty worried.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
哦，你还没去^0000FF棕榈森林^000000东边找过。真让人担心。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
You're back... and... Poby...
How is Poby?
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
你回来了...那...波比呢？
他怎么样了？

scripts.text: Poby.....
scripts.translation: 波比他...

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Ah! I didn't know that. I always tell Poby ^0000FF'Kemarau setahun rusak sehari.'^000000
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
唉！我还不知道他出了这种事。我总跟波比说：^0000FF“辛苦一年，一日尽毁。”^000000

scripts.text:
[Lero]
He climbed the tree without any safety equipment, so he might've fallen down and gotten injured.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
他没带任何防护装备就爬树，恐怕是摔下来受伤了。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Hmm... Sorry I couldn't get the Palm Oil right now.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
嗯...抱歉，现在没法给你棕榈油。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Will you deliver the message to Mr. Memo that it is impossible to get the oil due do to a lack of ingredients?
No artisans can create anything without ingredients.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
能不能把原料不足、暂时榨不出油的事转告梅莫先生？
巧妇难为无米之炊啊。

scripts.text: Why don't I get the ingredients?
scripts.translation: 我为什么不去收集原料？

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Ah, that can be a good way, but it will be hard to gather nuts as a starter.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
嗯，这主意不错，不过刚入门的人要收集坚果可不容易。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Hmm!!!
I have a good idea.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
嗯！！！
我想到办法了。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
You can ask Poby about the best method of gathering nuts where you met him in the forest. He should be able to teach you the technique.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
你可以去森林里遇见波比的地方问问他，怎样采坚果最有效。他应该能教你诀窍。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Although he is lazy and rather careless, he is the best worker.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
他虽然懒散又粗心，却是最能干的工人。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
You can ask Poby about the best method of gathering nuts where you met him in the forest. He should be able to teach you the technique.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
你可以去森林里遇见波比的地方问问他，怎样采坚果最有效。他应该能教你诀窍。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Although he is lazy and rather careless, he is the best worker.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
他虽然懒散又粗心，却是最能干的工人。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Did you gather the nuts already?
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
坚果都采齐了吗？

scripts.text:
[Lero]
One, two...
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
一、二...

scripts.text:
[Lero]
This isn't the number I ordered from Poby.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
这和我让波比准备的数量不一样。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
It's going to be difficult if it is delayed more, so hurry up and bring me 60.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
再拖下去就来不及了，快去给我拿 60 个来。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
One, two, three, four, . . . .
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
一、二、三、四...

scripts.text:
[Lero]
60 pieces of nuts, exactly. I will press the oil right now.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
正好 60 个。我这就榨油。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
It takes some time, so go back to Mr. Memo and tell him the situation. Also tell him that I'm sorry for the delay.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
榨油还要花些时间。你先回去把情况告诉梅莫先生，也替我向他道个歉，说我送晚了。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
It takes some time, so go back to Mr. Memo and tell him the situation. Also tell him that I'm sorry for the delay.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
榨油还要花些时间。你先回去把情况告诉梅莫先生，也替我向他道个歉，说我送晚了。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
You are carrying too much right now to continue.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
你现在负重太高，没法继续。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
You've come at the right time. I just finished making the palm tree oil.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
你来得正好，我刚榨好棕榈油。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
It is heavier than you might think, so be careful when carrying it.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
这油比你想的沉，搬运时小心些。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Oh, tell Mr. Memo that I'm sorry for the late delivery, and explain that it wasn't my fault.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
对了，替我向梅莫先生道歉，说货送晚了；也跟他说这可不是我的错。

scripts.text:
[Lero]

scripts.translation:

这油比你想的沉，搬运时小心些。

scripts.translation:

对了，替我向梅莫先生道歉，说货送晚了；也跟他说这可不是我的错。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
You are carrying too much right now to continue.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
你现在负重太高，没法继续。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
I clearly remembered giving you 30 bottles of palm tree oil, did you lose it all?
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
我明明给了你 30 瓶棕榈油，你该不会全弄丢了吧？

scripts.text: Sorry, it's my fault...
scripts.translation: 抱歉，是我的错...

scripts.text:
[Lero]
This is the palm tree oil which was in short supply. Be careful please. It was really hard to get this...
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
这就是之前短缺的棕榈油，拿好。弄到这些可费了不少劲...

scripts.text:
[Lero]
What did Mr. Memo say?
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
梅莫先生怎么说？

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Ah... I understand...
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
啊...我明白了...

scripts.text:
[Lero]
What happened? I didn't get a memo from Mr. Memo that he was going to send someone here.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
怎么回事？梅莫先生没告诉我他会派人过来啊。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Hey, I've been waiting for you. I didn't know that Poby's injury would make my life so difficult.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
嘿，我正等着你呢。波比受伤后，我才知道一个人干活有多辛苦。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
I'm ashamed to ask you this, but can you bring ^0000FF{0} pieces of oil palm nuts^000000 please?
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
真不好意思开口...能请你帮我带来^0000FF{0} 个油棕果^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Once you bring the oil palm nuts, Mr. Memo will exchange them with oil.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
你把油棕果带来后，梅莫先生就能用它们榨油。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Once you bring the 20 pieces of oil palm nuts, Mr. Memo will exchange them with oil.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
收集20颗油棕果后，梅莫先生就会帮你榨成油。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Once you bring the 40 pieces of oil palm nuts, Mr. Memo will exchange them with oil.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
收集40颗油棕果后，梅莫先生就会帮你榨成油。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Once you bring the 30 pieces of oil palm nuts, Mr. Memo will exchange them with oil.
scripts.translation:

收集30颗油棕果后，梅莫先生就会帮你榨成油。

You're carrying too much right now to continue.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
你现在负重太高，没法继续。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
One, two, three, four, . . . .
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
一、二、三、四...

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Exactly 20 pieces of oil palm nuts. Let you exchange them with oil right now.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
正好有20颗油棕果。现在就帮你榨油。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Exactly 40 pieces of oil palm nuts. Let you exchange them with oil right now.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
正好有40颗油棕果。现在就帮你榨油。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
Exactly 30 pieces of oil palm nuts. Let you exchange them with oil right now.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
正好有30颗油棕果。现在就帮你榨油。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
As I told you before, it is heavier than you might think, so be careful when carrying this.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
我之前说过，这油比你想的沉，搬运时务必小心。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
As I told you before, it is heavier than you might think, so be careful when carrying this.
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
我之前说过，这油比你想的沉，搬运时务必小心。

scripts.text:
[Lero]
What's going on with Poby...? Why hasn't he come back...?
scripts.translation:
[莱罗]
波比那边怎么样了...？他怎么还没回来...？

scripts.text: - Seems that he is waiting for someone-
scripts.translation: - 他似乎正在等人。 -

scripts.text:
[Poby]
Why are you carrying so much?
scripts.translation:
[波比]
你怎么带了这么多东西？

scripts.text:
[Poby]
You're going to regret it if you are carrying so much.
scripts.translation:
[波比]
带这么多东西，你迟早会后悔的。

scripts.text:
[Poby]
Ah~ backache...
scripts.translation:
[波比]
啊~ 腰好痛...

scripts.text: Are you Poby?
scripts.translation: 你是波比吗？

scripts.text:
[Poby]
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[波比]
你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Poby]
I do not know you, but
are you a fan of mine?
I'm Poby, the best fruit hunter in the Jaty tribe.
scripts.translation:
[波比]
我不认识你，不过...你是我的粉丝吗？
我是波比，贾提部落最棒的水果猎人。

scripts.text:
[Poby]
You here for my autograph?
scripts.translation:
[波比]
你是来找我签名的吗？

scripts.text: Lero made me come here.
scripts.translation: 莱罗让我来的。

scripts.text:
[Poby]
Ah! Mr. Lero made you come here. I can't move because I hurt my back while climbing a tree.
scripts.translation:
[波比]
啊！莱罗先生让你来的啊。我爬树时伤了腰，现在动不了。

scripts.text:
[Poby]
And I've still never had a girlfriend...
scripts.translation:
[波比]
而且我到现在连女朋友都没有...

scripts.text:
[Poby]
Ah! Sorry. Tell Mr. Lero that I will go back if I can find a way to move.
scripts.translation:
[波比]
啊！抱歉。请告诉莱罗先生，等我想到办法能动了，就会回去。

scripts.text:
[Poby]
I can't move at all 'cuz of this backache...
scripts.translation:
[波比]
腰疼得我完全动不了...

scripts.text:
[Poby]
Ah! Sorry. Tell Mr. Lero that I will go back if I can find a way to move.
scripts.translation:
[波比]
啊！抱歉。请告诉莱罗先生，等我想到办法能动了，就会回去。

scripts.text:
[Poby]
I can't move at all 'cuz of this backache...
scripts.translation:
[波比]
腰疼得我完全动不了...

scripts.text:
[Poby]
You got all the fruits. Bring them to Mr. Lero.
scripts.translation:
[波比]
果子都采齐了。带去交给莱罗先生吧。

scripts.text:
[Poby]
It's easiest for beginners like you to shake or kick the tree.
scripts.translation:
[波比]
像你这样的新手，摇树或踢树最容易采到果子。

scripts.text:
[Poby]
It might be dangerous, so always wear a ^0000FFSafety Helmet^000000.
scripts.translation:
[波比]
这可能有危险，记得戴上^0000FF安全帽^000000。

scripts.text:
[Poby]
Gather ^FF000060 ^0000FFPalm Oil Fruit^000000 and bring them to Mr. Lero.
scripts.translation:
[波比]
收集 ^FF000060 个^0000FF油棕果^000000，带给莱罗先生。

scripts.text:
[Poby]
Ah~ backache...
scripts.translation:
[波比]
啊~ 腰好痛...

scripts.text:
[Poby]
Oh!! You're-- Let me guess...
scripts.translation:
[波比]
哦！！你是——让我猜猜...

scripts.text:
[Poby]
...you're back! You plan to catch ^0000FFPalm Oil Fruit^000000 instead of me, right?
scripts.translation:
[波比]
...你回来了！是想替我去采^0000FF油棕果^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Poby]
It is hard for beginners to catch the fruit like me. No it's impossible.
scripts.translation:
[波比]
像我这样采果子，新手可做不到。不，根本不可能。

scripts.text:
[Poby]
Masters usually climb the tree to catch the fruit, but you're a beginner...
scripts.translation:
[波比]
老手通常会爬上树采果子，可你还是个新手...

scripts.text:
[Poby]
It's easiest for beginners to shake or kick the tree. It might be dangerous, so remember to wear a ^0000FFSafety Helmet^000000.
scripts.translation:
[波比]
对新手来说，摇树或踢树最容易采到果子。不过有危险，记得戴上^0000FF安全帽^000000。

scripts.text:
[Poby]
Ok! Gather ^FF000060^0000FF ^0000FFPalm Oil Fruit^000000 and bring that amount to Mr. Lero.
scripts.translation:
[波比]
好！收集 ^FF000060 个^0000FF ^0000FF油棕果^000000，按这个数量带去交给莱罗先生。

scripts.text:
[Poby]
Oh! {0}, we meet again. What's going on?
scripts.translation:
[波比]
哦！{0}，又见面了。怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Poby]
Oh! {0}, we meet again. What's going on?
- You explain the situation. -
scripts.translation:
[波比]
哦！{0}，又见面了。怎么了？
- 你向他说明了情况。 -

scripts.text:
[Poby]
Oh! {0}, we meet again. What's going on?
[Poby]
Good work! Be careful while delivering them~
scripts.translation:
[波比]
哦！{0}，又见面了。怎么了？
[波比]
干得好！送过去时小心点~

scripts.text:
[Poby]
Right... I owed Memo's grandfather. Wait, I hid some oil around here.
scripts.translation:
[波比]
对了...我还欠梅莫的祖父一些东西。等等，我记得在这附近藏了些油。

scripts.text:
[Poby]
I have some, but you seem to have too much stuff with you.
scripts.translation:
[波比]
我这儿是有一些，不过你身上好像带了太多东西。

scripts.text: - rummaging... rummaging... -
scripts.translation: - 翻找中...翻找中... -

scripts.text:
[Poby]
Ah! Here is another one. Take care not to lose it again. And keep it a secret from Mr. Lero.
scripts.translation:
[波比]
啊！这里还有一份。别再弄丢了。还有，可别告诉莱罗先生。

scripts.text:
[Poby]
Please~ {0}.
scripts.translation:
[波比]
拜托了~ {0}。

scripts.text: Why'd you come here?
scripts.translation: 你来这里做什么？

scripts.text: I want to know how to get fruit.
scripts.translation: 我想知道怎么采果子。

scripts.text:
[Poby]
I'm taking a walk because I think it will make my back ache less.
scripts.translation:
[波比]
我在散步，想着这样也许能缓解腰痛。

scripts.text:
[Poby]
It's easiest for beginners to shake or kick the tree.
scripts.translation:
[波比]
对新手来说，摇树或踢树最容易采到果子。

scripts.text:
[Poby]
It might be dangerous, so always wear a ^0000FFSafety Helmet^000000.
scripts.translation:
[波比]
这可能有危险，记得戴上^0000FF安全帽^000000。

scripts.text:
[Poby]
Ah~ my freakin' back is killing me.
scripts.translation:
[波比]
啊~ 这该死的腰疼得要命。

scripts.text: You are carrying too much.
scripts.translation: 你的负重太高了。

scripts.text:
There's a palm tree
facing the cool wind.
scripts.translation:
一棵棕榈树
迎着凉爽的微风。

scripts.text:
The palm tree denies
your greedy hands.
scripts.translation:
棕榈树不肯让你
这双贪婪的手靠近。

scripts.text:
There's a palm tree with fruits and flowers hanging from its branches.
Be sure to wear a Safety Helmet while trying to pick the fruit.
scripts.translation:
一棵棕榈树，枝头挂着果实和花朵。
采果子时务必戴好安全帽。

scripts.text:
There's a palm tree.
You can kick or shake it.
What do you want to do?
scripts.translation:
这里有棵棕榈树。
你可以踢它或摇晃它。
想怎么做？

scripts.text: Shake the tree
scripts.translation: 摇树

scripts.text: Kick the tree
scripts.translation: 踢树

scripts.text: You shake the palm tree.
scripts.translation: 你摇了摇棕榈树。

scripts.text: You kick the palm tree swiftly with all you might.
scripts.translation: 你卯足全力，迅速踢了棕榈树一脚。

scripts.text:
As you shake the palm tree...
but nothing happens.
scripts.translation:
你摇晃棕榈树……
但什么也没发生。

scripts.text:
As you give the palm tree a quick kick to its proverbial shin...
but nothing happens.
scripts.translation:
你踢了棕榈树的树干一脚……
但什么也没发生。

scripts.text:
As you shake the palm tree...
an ^0000FFOil Palm Fruit^000000 falls out.
scripts.translation:
你摇晃棕榈树……
一颗^0000FF油棕果^000000掉了下来。

scripts.text:
As you shake the palm tree...
a ^FF0000Worm Peeling^000000 falls out.
scripts.translation:
你摇晃棕榈树……
一片^FF0000虫蜕^000000掉了下来。

scripts.text:
As you shake the palm tree...
a ^FF0000Great Leaf^000000 falls out.
scripts.translation:
你摇晃棕榈树……
一片^FF0000巨大叶子^000000掉了下来。

scripts.text:
- Hold it right there!! -
- You're carrying too many items and don't have enough inventory space to receive any rewards. -
- Please make more inventory space available and come back to take this challenge. -
scripts.translation:
- 站住！！ -
- 你的物品太多，背包空间不足，无法领取奖励。 -
- 请腾出背包空间后，再回来接受挑战。 -

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Where in the hell am I? Everybody here is avoiding me.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我到底到了什么鬼地方？这里的人都躲着我。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Hey there, young man~ Are you from around here?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
嗨，小伙子~你是本地人吗？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Hey there, young lady~ Are you from around here?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
嗨，小姑娘~你是本地人吗？

scripts.text: No, I'm not.
scripts.translation: 不是。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I'd like to ask
you a question.
Where is this place?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我想问你一件事。
这里是什么地方？

scripts.text: - He seems to be asking for the Island name. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎是在问这座岛的名字。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's called {1}. What's wrong?

[Gatti]
This is Dewata Island? You're sure this is Dewata Island?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
这里是德瓦他岛？你确定这儿是德瓦他岛？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Hahahahahahahahaha...!!!
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
哈哈哈哈哈哈...！！！

scripts.text: - The old man started to laugh like a crazy person after hearing the name of the Island. You decide to ask a little bit later. -
scripts.translation: - 老人听到岛名后突然像疯了一样大笑。你决定过一会儿再问他。 -

scripts.text: - The old man gave a deep sigh of resignation and continued speaking. -
scripts.translation: - 老人无奈地长叹一声，接着说了下去。 -

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Damn... My plan is ruined. I invested all my fortunes to get there, but I failed. I can't do anything now, my boat has been wrecked.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
该死...我的计划全泡汤了。我把所有积蓄都投进去，结果还是没能找到。现在船也遇难了，我什么都做不了。

scripts.text:
- The old man starts to cry. -
- Feeling awkward, you quickly leave. -
scripts.translation:
- 老人开始哭了起来。 -
- 你觉得有些尴尬，赶紧离开了。 -

scripts.text: Well... Sir...
scripts.translation: 那个...先生...

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Cough... cough...

[Gatti]
Oh... Sorry~ Sorry. I was so happy that I finally arrived at Dewata Island.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
哦...抱歉~抱歉。我太高兴了，终于抵达德瓦他岛。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
This is not a short story. Oh! I have to introduce myself first. I am Mastersmith Gatti, also an Adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
说来话长。啊，我得先自我介绍。我是神工匠加蒂，也是一名冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I found a mysterious Weapon blueprint, but I don't remember exactly when I acquired it.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我找到了一张神秘的武器设计图，不过记不清具体是什么时候得到的了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Weapon Blueprint?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
武器设计图？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Yes! I traveled all around to find the materials for the weapon, but...
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
没错！我跑遍各地寻找打造这把武器的材料，可是...

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I couldn't find the last material anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我怎么也找不到最后一种材料。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I was about to give up, but there was some fine print on the blueprint saying that it could be found on the Dewata Island.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我都快放弃了，才发现设计图上有一行小字，说这种材料可以在德瓦他岛找到。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I don't know why somebody put such an important thing in fine print. Anyway, after reading that, I invested all my fortunes to find that Island.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
这么重要的信息，为什么要用小字写呢？总之，看到之后，我就花光了积蓄去找这座岛。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh... Is that so?

[Gatti]
This island is strange. I arrived here a week ago, and everybody here has been avoiding me.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
这座岛真奇怪。我一周前就到了，可这里的人一直躲着我。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Last week was so hard, but you saved me by telling me this is Dewata Island.
Thank you for telling me, and thank you for passing here at just the right time.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
上周可真难熬。幸好你告诉我这里是德瓦他岛，帮了我大忙。
谢谢你告知我实情，也谢谢你恰好在那时路过。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Uh... No problem.

[Gatti]
Well... There was a little problem of my ship getting wrecked, but that's neither here nor there.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
唉...虽然我的船也出了点意外，沉了，不过先不说这个。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Now that I found out this is Dewata Island, I should find the material for this great weapon.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
既然知道这里是德瓦他岛，我就该去找打造这把神兵的材料了。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Ah! the material that I am looking for is Comodo Leather.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
啊！我要找的材料是科摩多龙皮。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Comodo Leather?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
科摩多龙皮？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Yes. In the blueprint, it's written that only the recognized few of the Dewata Natives are worthy enough to fight against the Comodo Dragon.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
没错。设计图上说，只有少数得到德瓦他原住民认可的人，才有资格挑战科摩多龙。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
In order to fight the Comodo Dragon, you have to get recognized by the natives. I assume it'll be hard to get the recognition.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
要挑战科摩多龙，必须先得到原住民的认可。看来这认可不容易拿到。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course, it must be...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那当然...肯定不容易...

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Let me ask you a favor. If you get the recognition first, please don't forget to visit me.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
拜托你一件事。如果你先得到认可，别忘了回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
You possess a strong energy.
Have you seen a monster called a Comodo Dragon on this Island?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
您身上有股强大的气息。
您在这座岛上见过一种叫科摩多龙的魔物吗？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Lady, you possess a strong energy.
Have you seen a monster called a Comodo Dragon on this Island?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
女士，您身上有股强大的气息。
您在这座岛上见过一种叫科摩多龙的魔物吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I have.
scripts.translation: 见过。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Oh! Really?
I'm so lucky to have met you. This is going so well.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
哦！真的吗？
能遇见您真是太幸运了，事情进展得真顺利。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Would you please help me?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
能请您帮我个忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
The weapon material that I was looking for is ^0000FFComodo Leather^000000. Bring me 100 of them, and I will make you a fancy weapon.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我要找的武器材料是^0000FF科摩多龙皮^000000。请给我 100 张，我就为您打造一把华丽的武器。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I heard Comodo Dragons are very powerful monsters. Please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
听说科摩多龙非常强大，请务必小心。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Did you get recognized by the natives?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
你得到原住民的认可了吗？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I guess not yet. I'm asking around everywhere, but I couldn't find a way to get recognized from natives. I don't know when I could finish making this weapon.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
看来还没有。我到处打听，却始终找不到获得原住民认可的办法。也不知道何时才能把这把武器做出来。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
If you get the recognition before me, please DON'T forget to visit me.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
如果你比我先得到认可，千万别忘了回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
So, did you get recognized by the natives?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
那么，你得到原住民的认可了吗？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Oh yes! Finally.
You also possess a strong energy.
Did you finally get the recognition from natives?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
哦，太好了！总算等到了。
您身上也有股强大的气息。
您终于得到原住民的认可了吗？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Oh yes! Finally.
Lady, you also possess a strong energy.
Did you finally get the recognition from natives?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
哦，太好了！总算等到了。
女士，您身上也有股强大的气息。
您终于得到原住民的认可了吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Oh! Just as I expected!
I was so lucky to meet you. Everything is going so well.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
哦！我就知道！
能遇到你真是太幸运了，一切都很顺利。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I know I have no right to ask you for this, but meeting like this is a destiny...
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我知道自己没资格提出这种请求，不过我们的相遇一定是命运安排...

scripts.text: - Gatti mumbles. -
scripts.translation: - 加蒂低声嘟囔着。 -

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
The weapon material that I so longed for is ^0000FFComodo Leather^000000. Please get me 100 of them.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我梦寐以求的武器材料就是^0000FF科摩多龙皮^000000。请帮我收集 100 张。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I'm so eager to make the weapon in the weapon blueprint.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我已经迫不及待想按照武器设计图把武器做出来了。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Please, before my passion fades out.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
拜托了，趁我的热情还没消退...

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Oh! And Comodo Dragon is a very powerful monster, so please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
对了！科摩多龙非常强大，千万小心。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
By the looks of your walk, you must have brought me 100 Comodo Leather. Hand it over to me.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
看你走路的样子，应该带了 100 张科摩多龙皮吧？快交给我。

scripts.text: - Gatti takes the Comodo Leather from you. -
scripts.translation: - 加蒂从你手中接过科摩多龙皮。 -

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
So, that is the Comodo Leather. But not enough.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
这就是科摩多龙皮啊。不过，数量还不够。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I know I'm asking you a favor, but I need 100 of them.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我知道是在麻烦你，但我需要 100 张。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Please be careful because Comodo Dragon is very powerful monster. And don't forget to bring me 100 Comodo Leather on your way back.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
科摩多龙非常强大，务必小心。回来时别忘了带 100 张科摩多龙皮给我。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Oh~ Look at this. How resilient... So soft.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
哦~快看！真有韧性...摸起来又这么柔软。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Comodo Leather is the best material ever.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
科摩多龙皮真是绝佳的材料。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Yes, how should I process this?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
嗯，该怎么加工才好呢？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Hmm... Like this?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
嗯...这样？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Or like that? Yes! This is the way!
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
还是那样？对了！就该这么做！

scripts.text:
- Mastersmith Gatti is enjoying to process the Leathers you've brought to make the weapon. -
- You should wait a little while. -
scripts.translation:
- 神工匠加蒂正兴致勃勃地加工你带来的皮革，准备制作武器。 -
- 请稍等片刻。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... Gatti?

[Gatti]
Oh! Sorry, sorry! This leather is so interesting.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
啊！抱歉抱歉！这皮革实在太有意思了。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I made a hilt out of the leather you brought me.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我用你带来的皮革做了一个印度尼西亚短剑柄。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hilt?

[Gatti]
You don't know what a hilt is? That's what you call the handle of a weapon.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
你不知道什么是剑柄吗？就是武器的握柄。

scripts.text: - Gatti shows a thing that looks like a handle of a weapon. -
scripts.translation: - 加蒂拿出一个看起来像武器握柄的东西给你看。 -

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I tried making it like what's written in the blueprint, but I need more material.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我试着按照设计图来做，可是还需要更多材料。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Really?

[Gatti]
Yes... To be frank with you, I ruined a lot of them trying different things.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
是啊...坦白说，我试了好几种做法，浪费了不少材料。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I know this is a lot to ask, but can you get me 100 more Comodo Leather, 20 Steel, and 10 Oridecon?
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我知道这要求很多，不过你能再帮我找 100 张科摩多龙皮、20 块钢和 10 个神之金属吗？

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I'll make you a best weapon ever.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我会给你打造一把最棒的武器。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Oh! I almost forgot. Don't forget to bring the hilt that I just made you.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
啊！差点忘了。别忘了带上我刚做好的短剑柄。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
A weapon must have a handle.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
武器总得有个握柄嘛。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
You brought all the material already?
You were also curious about the finished weapon? Haha.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
材料都带来了吗？
你也很好奇成品会是什么样吧？哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Hmm... I need more of those. If my ship didn't get wrecked, I could made it on my own, but...
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
嗯...还得再多准备些材料。要是我的船没出事，我本可以自己去找，可是...

scripts.text: - Gatti mumbles to himself. -
scripts.translation: - 加蒂自言自语。 -

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
100 Comodo Leather, 20 Steel, and 10 Oridecon are what I need.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
我需要 100 张科摩多龙皮、20 块钢和 10 个神之金属。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
If you bring them all, I'll make the best weapon ever.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
这些材料都凑齐的话，我就给你打造一把最棒的武器。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Great! We have enough. Wait a little.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
太好了！材料够了。稍等一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I finished making the weapon. This is called Caress according to the blueprint.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
武器做好了。设计图上说，它的名字叫“印度尼西亚短剑”。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
I keep finding new stuffs when I lay my eyes on this blueprint.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
每次看这张设计图，我都能发现新的细节。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
Now, I learned how to make the weapon, ask me any time if you need it.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
现在我已经学会怎么打造这把武器了。你需要的话，随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
You're {0},
So, how's the Caress that I made you?
[Gatti]
You brought the material for the Hilt. I'll make it right away.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
{0}，
我给你打造的印度尼西亚短剑用得怎么样？
[加蒂]
短剑柄的材料带来了吗？我这就开始制作。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
You're {0},
So, how's the Caress that I made you?
[Gatti]
You have all the materials. Wait just a little.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
{0}，
我给你打造的印度尼西亚短剑用得怎么样？
[加蒂]
材料都齐了。稍等一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
You're {0},
So, how's the Caress that I made you?
[Gatti]
You only have a Hilt. You'll need to bring me 10 Oridecon, 20 Steel, and 70 Comodo Leather.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
{0}，
我给你打造的印度尼西亚短剑用得怎么样？
[加蒂]
你手上只有短剑柄。还需要给我 10 个神之金属、20 块钢和 70 张科摩多龙皮。

scripts.text:
[Gatti]
You're {0},
So, how's the Caress that I made you?
[Gatti]
So, you want to reinforce your weapon? The weapon gets broken from time to time during the process, but it doesn't happen that often.
[Gatti]
If you want to do it, I'll have to tell you some cautionary things before reinforcing the Caress.
scripts.translation:
[加蒂]
{0}，
